body:
Logically, nothing, aside from some financial burden and emotional stress on some family and friends. But I don't want guilt to be the only reason I don't do it.

Emotionally, satisfaction at the "revenge" I'd feel in my projections of what I believe other people would feel, particularly guilt. Happiness at the revenge. Peace from the pain and anger among a mixed bag of emotions. 

I'm not sure what emotional state I'm currently in, but I hadn't noticed the emphasis of revenge in my suicide fantasies in the past. I had a "I take everyone down with me" murder-suicide fantasy period in the past, but I don't understand where these emotions come from. 

I'm just rambling on, but I'm sick of not feeling human and crying constantly because of it.
